target_claim: For every prime P_k, floor(P_k+2√P_k)+1 is even and therefore cannot be prime.
source_quote: The above implies that both intervals contain the same primes. We also point out that the upper bound of the larger interval, $\left\lfloor P_k+2\sqrt{P_k}\right\rfloor+1$, cannot be a prime since it is an even number for any $k$.
